book.name: HEBREWS
book.title: HEBREW sinmuy amuṅaqw Tuptsiwni’yuṅqamuy amumi Pēni

content: The Priest Melchizedek
Pi i’ hapi hak Melchisedec Salem ep moṅwi, pas Sus’oveqnihqat God awwat wimmoṅwi. Ura pam Abraham ahsawvaqe, aw öqala, pam momṅwituy haqam súlawhtiqat aṅqw ahoy pitutoq’ö.

Noqw Abraham sohsok hihta sun pakwút‐sikivo oyiwyuṅqat aṅqw sūkw oyiwhqat put maqa. (Melchisedec tuṅwniyat namtökiwhqe moṅwi súan hinmaqa i’nihqe pam’i; nīk̇aṅw pay pam piw Salem ep móṅw’iwtaqe ōviy moṅwi kwakwhat unaṅway’taqa yan túṅwantiwa, pi Salem kwakwhat qatsi i’nihqe pam’i.

Hak náatnihqat, pu yúatnihqat qa haqe’ pey’ta, pu hakim put kwámatnihqam qa navotiwta, sen tímatnihqam qa navotiwta. Pam hisat tihtiwhqat, pu hisat mokqat pam qa pey’ta. Pam yan God Tiyat an yukiwta; pam yūmosa God awwat moṅw’iwta.)
Meh, i’ hak pas pavan a’nö hímuu. Ura Abraham itahwu’ya hakimuy momṅwituy kīqötaqe pumuy poswa; nihqe tukwhaniy pakwút‐sikivo oyahtaqe, sūkw oyiwhqat Melchisedec aw noa.

Noqw Moses pan tutaptaqw, imuy Jew‐sinmuy amuṅaqw God awwat momṅwit, Levit ahpiyvimat pan tuwi’yuṅwa. Puma sinomuy amuṅaqw hihta pakwút‐sikivo oyiwyuṅqat aṅqw sūkw oyiwhqat ömalalwaṅwu, nāmahin pi as puma sinomuy amún Abraham tímatu.
Noqw Melchisedec as qa Levit‐sinomuy amuhpiynik̇aṅw, Abraham aṅqw put ömahtat, pu Abraham öqala, pay pi ura God Abraham öqalaniqey āawna.
Noqw itam navoti’yuṅqw, hak pavansino hapi söqavuṅwsinot öqalaniṅwu.
Noqw ima Levit ahpiyvimat sinomuy amuṅaqw sivit ömahtotaqam pay soa; noqw pay i’ Melchisedec itanay Abraham aṅqw put ömahtaqa pam mokqat i’ qa haqam tutuvenit aṅ pey’ta.
Pu as nu piw paṅqawniqw i’ Levi sivit ömalawhqa soñawnen Abraham ahpiy put pan oyiwtaqat Melchisedec aw mātavi.
Ispi Melchisedec Abraham ahsawvaqw, soñawnen pam Levit qeniyat ep wunu, ōviy pi Levi put ahpiyviyniq’ö.

Ima Jew‐sinom God awwat momṅwituy, Levit ahpiyvimuyatuy amuhpiy tutavot makiwya. Noqw pay pumuy tumalaam qa pasiwtaqw, ōviy nawus God sukwat moṅwtavi‐it Jesus Christ. Pam hapi qa Aaron ahpiy’o, nīk̇aṅw pam Melchisedec an moṅwtaviwa, God ahpiy’o.
Noqw ason God hakiy Judat ahpiyviyat moṅwtave’, nawus pahsat pam tutavot alöṅtani.
Pi itam navoti’yuṅqw, Jesus qa Levit ahpiynit, Judat ahpiy’o. Puma hapi as qa wimmoṅwnamorstiwya; pu Moses qa pumuy put tumalmaqa.
Another Priest, like Melchizedek
Pu nāt pas i’ piw susmataq’a: Pas hapi Christ Melchisedec antaqa God awwat moṅwtaviwa.
Pam nāitniwniqat tutavot qa put ahpiynit, pas qatsit qaso’taqat öqalayat ahpiy put aw taviwa.
Pi pam put pan lalvaya: Um hapi Melchisedec tuwiyat an pas sūs God awwat moṅw’iwta.
Suyan pi mohti hin tutaptiwhqa qa öqalaniqe, pu qa apitiqe ōviy ayo yukiwa.

Pi pam pep hin tutavo qa hakiy pas suyan hin hintaniqat antsana; noqw pay tutavo ayo yukiwhq, itam pu’ hapi hihta pas pavan nukṅwat aw yanyuṅwa, it Jesus aw’i; nihqe put hapi ahpiy itam God aw ökiwta.
Meh, God Jesus put awwat moṅwtapqe pas pavan put aw lavayvasiwna.

Ura pam hisat Aaron ahpiyvituy moṅw’oyhqe, qa hihta pumuy amumi pas suyan pasiwna. Nīk̇aṅw pam Jesus moṅwtapqe, put aw pasiwnaqe aw paṅqawu: Tutuyqawhqa hapi pas öqalat lavayhtiqe soon alöṅtani; nihqe pam ūmi yan lavayhti: Um hapi pas Melchisedec tuwiyat anwat God awwat pas sūs moṅwtaviwa.
Noqw ōviy God itamumi hihta nukṅwat pasiwnaqw, Christ pas nāp put aw antsanhtani.
Pu pay pas pi antsa Aaron ahpiyvit k̇aysiwhqam God awwat moṅw’iwyuṅwa, pi himuwa mōk̇e’, paṅso pahsavoniṅwuniqw ōviy’o.
Noqw Christ hapi pas sutsep qátuhqe, ōviy qa nahlakṅwuqat God awwat moṅwqenit makiway’ta.
Pantaqw hapi ōviy pam put aṅ God aw ökiwtaqamuy pas sūs ayo óyaniqey aw öqalat pasiwta, suyan pi sutsep qátuk̇aṅw, amuṅem lavayi’maniqey ōviy’o.
Pi pantaqa God awwat susmohpeq moṅwi súitamuhpee, qahováriwtaqa, qa nukpana, qa hihta akw hintaqa, qaanhinwisqamuy amuṅaqw lahsiwtaqa, pas ōveqatsit yupqövaqe pákihqa.
God awwat momṅwit pi nāqavo put aw hihtuy qö́yantotaṅwu, mohti nanāp qaanhtipuy epnit, aṅk pu sinmuy qaanhtipuyamuy ep’e. Noqw Christ pi qa pumuy amún hinhtiqe, sūs nātavi.
Tutavo pi pay sinmuy qa pasiwyuṅqamuy God awwat moṅwtaṅalawu. Noqw pay God tutavot ayo yúkuhqe, öqalvasiwnit akw pas nāp Tiy pas suyan pasiwtaqat put aw sūs pana.
